units.source_text: 可是，他在無意識之中搞笑，對搞笑的悲哀渾然不知，這正是我們倆在本質上的不同。

en.t: But he made jokes unconsciously and had no idea of the sadness in joking; that was precisely the essential difference between the two of us.

units.source_text: 只是在一起玩，只當他是一位玩伴。

en.t: I was merely playing around with him and regarded him only as a playmate.

units.source_text: 我常常在心裡蔑視他，有時甚至恥於與他為伍，

en.t: I often despised him in my heart, and at times I was even ashamed to be associated with him,

units.source_text: 卻又與他結伴而行，不知不覺中，我被這個男人打敗了。

en.t: yet I still went around with him, and before I knew it, I had been defeated by this man.

units.source_text: 起初我認為他是個好人，一個難得的好人，

en.t: At first I thought he was a good person, a rare and unusually good person,

units.source_text: 連怯生怕人的我對他也都沒有絲毫的戒心，認為遇到了一位東京的好向導。

en.t: Even I, timid and afraid of people, felt not the slightest wariness toward him and thought I had found a good guide to Tokyo.
